title: America's Cleaning of the Storage: Director's Cut
overview: A re-edited version of America's Cleaning Of The Storage, done as a full episode. First aired as a special between seasons 2 and 3, and later included on the Hetalia Fan Disc.

title: Episode 53.5: The Diary of the Awesome Me (2)
overview: A special unaired episode included on the Hetalia Fan Disc. Continues the story of Prussia and Hungary as kids from the first episode of Hetalia: World Series.

title: Chibitalia
overview: A re-edited version of the Chibitalia segments from the first season done as a full episode. Included on the Hetalia Fan Disc.

title: The Indigenous People of Iceland?
overview: Iceland meets up with the rest of the Nordic states to reveal the results of a test to find out who his ancestors were.

title: Today is Halloween
overview: The countries of the world celebrate Halloween. Also, Italy and Germany reminisce about old times.

title: The Story So Far
overview: China worries about the other nations of the world trying to invade his land and get his opium. America uses a 1942 notebook computer to calculate a route from America to Germany. Also features adaptation of "Previously in Hetalia".

title: Hetalia = Fantasia
overview: The episode adapts the plot of the Drama CD Hetalia Fantasia. The Axis and the Allies take a small trip inside a Role-Playing Game.

title: Buon San Valentino (1)
overview: Germany may be a good strategist, but he isn't very good at reading emotions. So naturally, when he questions the nature of his and Italy's relationship, things get a bit...complicated.

title: Buon San Valentino (2)
overview: Things quickly become tangled as Germany tries to sort out his "feelings" for Italy. As it turns out, Italy and Germany's thoughts aren't exactly in alignment.

title: The Centennial Gift
overview: It's America's two-hundredth birthday, and England finally plucks up the courage to do something nice for him.

title: Liechtenstein and the Hedgehog Country
overview: Liechtenstein wonders what her big brother Switzerland does during the war.

title: I Was Overwhelmed by Heroines
overview: Estonia falls asleep during a World Meeting one day and is shocked to find that all of the nations have been turned into girls.

title: Germany and Cohabitation
overview: Germany talks about living with Austria.

title: Netherlands and Isolationist Japan
overview: Netherlands attempts to make Japan open up to the outside world a little.

title: The Ruler of Scandinavia and The King of Eastern Europe
overview: As they prepare for battle against Lithuania and Poland, Finland tells Sweden a story about a battle between Poland and Lithuania and the Teutonic Knights.

title: Surprise Halloween!
overview: America hosts a grand Halloween party, but the party features a costume contest!? England was the only one who didn't know about the contest, and the reason is....
